text:
Sam: FYI — customer reported rerank API returning 413 and an opaque error when they send long query + many docs. They hit it during a bulk search workflow.
Jules: Can you paste the raw error and a repro curl?
Sam: Error from logs: `HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large`
`{ "error": "request size exceeds maximum allowed" }`
Sam: Repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -d @payload.json`
Sam: payload.json had `query` ~ 3.5k chars, docs: 120 passages avg 1500 chars each. Token estimate ~ 250k.
Priya: Thanks — sounds like two different constraints: per-request token ceiling and a max-docs ceiling. Current message only says "request size" which is unhelpful.
Marco: Product: customer wants actionable guidance — e.g. "Reduce query length or number of docs (max 100) or use `snippet` field". Also they'd like the API to return which limit was hit.
Jules: I reproduced locally with a synthetic payload. Server log: `rerank: input_tokens=248123 max_tokens=200000` and `num_docs=120 max_docs=100`. We return 413 before running scoring, so we can augment response.
Priya: Proposal: change HTTP 413 body to include {"error":"input_token_limit_exceeded","provided_tokens":248123,"token_limit":200000,"provided_docs":120,"doc_limit":100}. That keeps backward compat but actionable.
Sam: +1. Also propose client-side helper error text example for KB.
Priya: Quick patch ready: API code will check both ceilings and return a distinct error code. Will send PR by EOD.
Jules: SRE check: does this affect any proxies? 413 can be generated at nginx too. Confirmed it's from app layer here. I'll add an alert rule for spike in 413-rerank errors.
Marco: UX wording suggestion for KB & error message: "Request exceeds rerank limits (tokens: provided 248k / limit 200k). Reduce query or docs, or send shorter snippets per doc. See https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank-limits" :thumbsup: 
Sam: Customer-facing repro steps I gave them: 1) try sending only top 20 docs, 2) trim query to 1-2 sentences, 3) use `passage` or `snippet` field. They asked for an example curl showing chunking — sample below.
Sam: ```
# simple chunking pseudocode
for chunk in chunk_docs(docs, max_docs=50):
  res = call_rerank(query, chunk)
  aggregate(res)
```
Sam: curl example: `curl -X POST ... -d '{"query":"short...","documents":[...] }'`
Priya: I'll add a `x-redwood-error-code` header too with values like `tokens_exceeded` so SDKs can programmatically detect.
Jules: Assigning tasks: Priya -> PR to include detailed payload fields + header. Jules -> SRE alert and a short dashboard showing 413s by channel. Sam -> update KB and send customer a tailored note. Marco -> review KB wording.
Sam: Noted. I'll update ticket with triage and tentative ETA 24h for PR + KB.
Priya: Quick note — need to confirm max_docs value for dedicated customers differs; we'll include `doc_limit_source` in response (e.g., "tenant_config" vs "defaults").
Jules: Good catch. Make sure response includes `limit_scope":"tenant"|"global"`.
Sam: Thanks everyone. I'll ping again after PR merges. :rocket:
